hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Samson post and center bearing
function: The A-frame that carries the walking beam on the center bearing, taking the whole rod load plus the counterbalance.

tabs.overview: Three legs to a saddle bearing; the beam pivots here so the horsehead end and the tail end move opposite ways.
tabs.safety: Ladder access only with the unit braked.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
